key_insight: HierSTT is a hierarchical Transformer that forecasts ED demand coherently across hospital, regional, and national levels in one end-to-end model.
clinical_relevance: More consistent forecasts can help EDs and health planners align staffing, bed capacity, and system-wide resource allocation.
method: Uses a Temporal Fusion Transformer to model national-level dynamics.
Uses spatio-temporal Transformer encoder-decoder modules for regional and hospital forecasts conditioned on higher-level predictions.
Adds a coherence-aware loss to reduce mismatches across hierarchy levels.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on a nationwide Portuguese ED dataset from 81 hospitals across 5 regional health administrations, with the model reducing average WAPE by 32% versus the best non-hierarchical deep learning baseline.
watch_item: Real-world deployment may require careful handling of missing data, changing hospital patterns, and the need to maintain consistency as healthcare systems evolve.
paper_title: Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Coherent Emergency Department Forecasting
